full_name: Vicki Caron | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2008–2009 History Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Cornell University
bio: Vicki Caron is the Diann G. and Thomas A. Mann Professor of Modern Jewish Studies at Cornell University, where she holds a joint appointment in the history department and the Program of Jewish Studies.
